scope: Actual browser editor/content-module diagnostics; no tail or total-process peak qualification
limitStatus: Exact diagnostic workload sizes fixed before measurement; existing fitness-v1 budgets preserved; latency/memory release thresholds unreviewed
memoryScope: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage without forced GC at explicit replay boundaries; observed JS/backing-storage maxima, not native decoder/process peaks
inputScope: Public atomic commands and programmatic native DOM/control selections; no trusted input/compositor/OS accessibility claim
contentLayout: Public fragment insertion retains two empty editable boundary blocks around opaque content; these are included in every full semantic oracle
frameScope: Two animation callbacks can share one refresh timestamp; retain duplicates; compositor and distinct-frame qualification unobserved
seedMethod: Long logical line: constructor chunks <=131072 UTF-16 units split only at scalar boundaries, then public joins; bidi: constructor whole blocks; modules: public fragment with canonical fallback
warmupPolicy: WASM initialized before each mount timer; twelve sequential replays, no discarded warmup samples
seedContext: Isolated preparation context closed before both fresh preset contexts
semanticPolicy: Preserve exact text, attributes, arrays and all distinct mark boundaries; canonical object keys and merge only adjacent runs with identical complete mark maps; retain raw initial run segments
